entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Aw yeah! This time tomorrow,[n]we're gonna be in Hawaii!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I can't wait!
It should be fun.
You have your time wrong.
It's gonna be boring.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I'm so pumped!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yeah, we'll still be in[n]Japan at that point...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: At least try and be even[n]a little excited about it!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Ryuji! You know you're not leaving[n]until tomorrow night, right?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Wait, for real!?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Enough of the chitchat. You[n]should be concentrating on class.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I don't care about that after[n]what I just heard. I'm totally[n]outta motivation to work...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Sounds like business as usual.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Welp, time to research[n]sightseeing spots in Hawaii!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You got over that[n]pretty damn fast!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh yeah, are there any famous[n]places in Los Angeles?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Hollywood!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It has a vibrant art scene as[n]well. I expect the trip will[n]prove quite stimulating.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That don't hold a candle to[n]Hawaii's beaches though.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: There are a multitude of[n]fabulous beaches near Los[n]Angeles as well, you know.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Huh? It's close to the ocean...?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Do you... know where LA is?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Well it's the capital of America,[n]so... in the middle somewhere?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: What about Hawaii?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Dunno. Some ocean, I guess?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: You're hopeless!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: How long are you all going[n]to keep this up!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...Come on. Can't you guys be more[n]mature about this?
